sentences.en: He himself also wrote unsigned pamphlets justifying the campaign of 1870.

sentences.en: At one point, quite unsigned, by a Sustrans marker, is a big concrete monolith.

sentences.en: If the left-hand operand is unsigned, the right shift is a logical shift so the upper bits will be filled with zeros.

sentences.en: The Unsigned Hour, Sunday 9pm, has yet to put anyone onto the station's playlist.

sentences.en: They also impressed at the 2006 UK Unsigned showcases and were selected to play at the Bulldog Bash Festival at Stratford in August.

sentences.en: They also have a tie-in with The Big Issue, with talented, unsigned artists being compiled for a cover CD.
